test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The wounds on my back are no longer fresh, but, somehow, they still ______.
solution: The correct answer is option no.(4) i.e. **'hurt'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence implies that the wounds have been healed but it gives pain or hurt. • The word** Hurt **means to give pain or sufferings.(पीड़ा, आघात पहुंचाना, चोट लगा हुआ) • Example: His bitter words **hurt** me a lot. • So,'**Hurt'** will be the word appropriate for the given blank. Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Other options are: • **Revamp: **Give new and improved form, structure, or appearance.(सुधार, नवीनीकरण करना) • **Barge: **A long flat-bottomed boat for carrying freight on canals and rivers.(माल लादने की चौड़े पेंदे वाली नाव) • **Enrich: **Improve or enhance the quality or value.(समृद्ध करना, संपन्न बनाना) 1b0:T9f9, సరైన సమాధానం ఎంపిక నంబర్ (4) అంటే **'hurt'.**
